facts.value: I discovered the BA in Irish Dance through my dance teacher who had studied at UL.
facts.programme_association: Irish Dance - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: Three years before starting the course, my parents and I came from France to visit the campus.
facts.programme_association: Irish Dance - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: The Academy is like a family. We work very closely with our tutors and can go to them with any issues or questions.
facts.programme_association: Irish Dance - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: The variety of classes surprised me.
facts.programme_association: Irish Dance - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: I wasn’t expecting to have so many opportunities for self-development with ballet, yoga and even hip hop as well as my core Irish dance classes.
facts.programme_association: Irish Dance - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: One of the most exciting opportunities during my studies was working with Breandán de Gallaí’s youth company on a creative residency on an island off the coast of Donegal.
facts.programme_association: Irish Dance - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: Together, we devised and performed an original piece for the renowned Earagail Arts Festival.
facts.programme_association: Irish Dance - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: Another standout moment in my final year was the privilege of performing with Dr de Gallaí’s professional company, Ériu, at a special anniversary gala – an unforgettable experience!
facts.programme_association: Irish Dance - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: My advice to incoming students would be to take the course seriously.
facts.programme_association: Irish Dance - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: You have to be mentally and physically prepared to do a programme like this.
facts.programme_association: Irish Dance - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: It is important to eat and sleep well, to take care of yourself and to practice.
facts.programme_association: Irish Dance - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: This will position you to get the best out of the course.
